blogs.title: What is Orthogonal Finetuning? A Friendly Intro for Non‑Researchers
blogs.description: Dive into the core idea behind Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) and why preserving neuron angles matters. This post explains the motivation and basic mechanism in plain language, using everyday analogies and visual diagrams.

blogs.title: The Butterfly Effect: Why a Classic FFT Structure Powers Modern AI Finetuning
blogs.description: Explore how the butterfly structure from the Cooley‑Tukey Fast Fourier Transform is repurposed to build parameter‑efficient orthogonal matrices. We walk through the math in a high‑level way and show why this topology lets you send information quickly with fewer trainable weights.

blogs.title: From Block Diagonal to Butterfly: The Evolution of Orthogonal Finetuning
blogs.description: Trace the journey from the original block‑diagonal OFT to the new Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT) method. This comparison highlights trade‑offs in expressivity, parameter count, and inductive bias, with clear before/after visuals.

blogs.title: Why Parameter Efficiency Matters for Foundation Models (And how BOFT Helps)
blogs.description: Discuss the practical costs of training huge models from scratch, introduce parameter‑efficient finetuning (PEFT), and explain how BOFT’s $O(d	ext{log}d)$ parameter count makes it a game‑changer for adapting large vision, language, and diffusion models.

blogs.title: Inside BOFT: The Information Transmission View Explained
blogs.description: Unpack the paper’s novel viewpoint that constructing a dense orthogonal matrix is like transmitting data through a graph. A step‑by‑step diagrammatic walk‑through shows how sparsity patterns translate into efficient neural‑network updates.

blogs.title: Hands‑On: Implementing Orthogonal Butterfly Finetuning in PyTorch
blogs.description: A practical tutorial that guides readers through coding a BOFT layer in PyTorch, covering Cayley parametrization, identity initialization, multiplicative dropout, and how to plug BOFT into an existing transformer or vision backbone.

blogs.title: "Generalization on Steroids": How Orthogonal Inductive Bias Boosts AI Adaptation
blogs.description: "Generalization" here refers not only to new data distribution but also to avoiding catastrophic forgetting. This article discusses the spectral benefits of orthogonality, explores BOFT's implicit bias toward classic linear transforms, and links theory to reported gains across vision & NLP tasks.

blogs.title: "Beyond Text‑to‑Image": Breadth of Applications for Orthogonal Finetuning
blogs.description: "From computer vision classification to language modeling", this post surveys experiments showing BOFT’s strong performance across many downstream tasks—illustrating its versatility beyond its original intro domain.

blogs.title: "Speed vs Size": Trade‑Offs When Using Butterfly vs Classical PEFT Methods
blogs.description: "LoRA vs BOFT vs Adapter tuning"—an accessible comparison of training time, memory overhead, number of trainable parameters, and inference latency for each approach; includes practical tips on choosing the right method.
